description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
